UPDATE t_part_batch
            SET status                  = 'IN_PROCESS',
                location                = 'PRODUCTION_SHELF',
                current_holder_id       = $3,
                current_process_step_id = NULL,
                version                 = version + 1,
                updated_at              = now(),
                updated_by              = $4
            WHERE id = $1
              AND version = $2
              AND status = 'PENDING'
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
